policy: Partial mission progress is derived only from one persisted admissible world-event evidence record. The caller never chooses a progress percentage. Team doctrine may improve how efficiently real evidence advances an objective, but can never manufacture evidence, guarantee terminal success, or replace the objective's terminal evidence gate.
invariants: One evidence event can advance one mission objective through this command at most once.
Evidence admissibility and mission causality are validated by the existing mission evidence gate.
Partial progress is nondecreasing and never reaches terminal success through this command.
Mission doctrine is an efficiency modifier over real evidence, not a source of success or hidden information.
No random complication, opposition, clue, casualty, or objective result is created by progress resolution.
Terminal succeeded/failed objective states remain owned by mission_objective_update with admissible terminal evidence.
